note: The claim adjustment group and reason codes the commercial EOB's 835 uses, each with what it records and its public source. Code values only: no code description is written into any file.

groups.use: contractual obligation: an amount the provider may not bill the patient

reasons.use: the charge above the allowed amount: in network, on a No Surprises Act protected line, and the part of a visit-limit charge above the network rate
the charge above the allowed amount an out-of-network provider without protection may bill the patient
the plan's yearly visit limit reached: what the patient owes
no prior authorization, in network: the provider may not bill the patient
no prior authorization, out of network: the patient may owe the charge

claimFiling.source: X12 005010X221A1, CLP06 claim filing indicator code list
